title: Water Can Boil Itself Into Ice in a Vacuum

scenes.text: Water can boil and freeze at the same time.
Put a dish of water in a vacuum chamber and pump out the air.
As the pressure drops, the water starts to boil.
Boiling pulls heat out of the water, like sweat cooling your skin.
Soon it's so cold that ice forms while it's still bubbling.
At less than one percent of normal air pressure, water can be ice, liquid and steam at once. Boiling and freezing, together.

description:
Water can boil and freeze at the same time.
In a vacuum, water boils and the boiling pulls out so much heat that the rest of it freezes. At the triple point it can be ice, liquid and steam together.
What other physics fact sounds fake but isn't?
first_comment: Boiling and freezing at once. What physics fact still breaks your brain?
